en.title: Low pay, job insecurity for China's trainee doctors a turn-off for young talent
en.summary: Medical students in China are reconsidering careers in healthcare due to concerns about low compensation and unstable employment prospects. A fifth-year clinical student in Guangxi province exemplifies this trend, considering switching to consulting despite initially pursuing medicine during the pandemic.
